mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Area High School with a temperature of 58 degrees. It is a perfect night to spot the International Space Station, which will pass over from Mount Horeb toward Fitchburg and Madison at 3:24 AM, appearing about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona is hiring an Engineering Technician for public works projects; apply by September 20. Also, please note that new sewer and stormwater utility rates are now in effect to support necessary infrastructure maintenance and prevent system failures.

We have a busy weekend ahead starting today with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, plus Girls Try Hockey at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness, and keep an eye out for trivia and markets starting early next week.
In a notable call from August 15, officers arrested a driver for an O W I first offence after the vehicle was observed swerving and the driver was found asleep at the wheel.
Treat yourself to the Caramel Cashew flavor of the day. The store is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
